name: Bropilot
purpose: Help people build self-sustaining software systems without having held every startup role
summary: Bropilot turns a hazy idea into a committed representation that an agent team can act on. You answer structured questions; each answer stages effects on a knowledge graph; you commit; agents build, deploy and measure; reality feeds back. Built to describe itself.

name: Ledgerly
purpose: Freelancers get paid on time and always know what cash is coming
summary: Invoicing, polite payment chasing and a 60-day cash forecast for freelancers and their accountants

name: Tidepool
purpose: Turn volunteer shore walks into survey data marine biologists can publish on
summary: An offline-first field app for timed intertidal transects, with photo ID help and expert verification
